principle: Verifiable assurance for specific claims in a specific context at a specific time; never a universal trust score.

limitations: payer is the operator-controlled test buyer, so this proves public operation and repeatability potential, not independent demand
Base Sepolia is testnet and this is not production revenue
single-call latency is not a performance baseline; free-tier cold start and payment-facilitator latency must be separated with repeated calls

globalProofs.limitation: Health is degraded only because the optional Judge provider is not configured.

scope: review/block do not execute in mediator model

globalProofs.tool: TLA+ TLC 2.19 / pinned v1.7.4 tool bundle
scope: hard merchant/beneficiary/amount/currency/freshness/replay bindings are required before verified/approved/executed states
approved/executing/executed requires mandate or observed human approval
payment state alone never grants authority
replay or any hard mismatch cannot execute
execution count never exceeds one in the specified state machine

limitations: model checking proves invariants of the specified/modelled state spaces, not every possible program/environment state
does not prove external-world truth or upstream registry integrity
does not prove arbitrary LLM correctness
does not yet prove every downstream execution adapter is refinement-equivalent to the TLA+ model
does not guarantee zero fraud, merchant fulfilment or financial recovery
A5 requires independent external attestation and is never self-awarded
